title: Steering the Flow: Inverting Face Recognition Models via Gradient-Guided Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2608.16791v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Model Inversion Attacks (MIAs) aim to reconstruct representative training samples of target identities from face recognition models, exposing critical security vulnerabilities. Existing methods typically rely on indirect guidance or highly stochastic guidance, making it difficult to stably optimize generation trajectories toward target facial images. In this paper, we propose Steering Flow Model Inversion (SFMI), a novel two-stage white-box model inversion method that reformulates inversion as a trajectory-steering task. Specifically, Step I, Learning a Generic Flow Matching Prior, pre-trains a generic unconditional Flow Matching model to encode the manifold of human faces as a robust prior. Step II, Attacking with Progressive Guidance Scheduler (PGS), injects time-dependent target-specific gradients during sampling. translated_title: 引导生成流：通过梯度引导的流匹配逆向人脸识别模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16791v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：模型逆向攻击（MIAs）旨在从人脸识别模型中重建目标身份的代表性训练样本，从而暴露关键的安全漏洞。现有方法通常依赖间接引导或高度随机引导，这使得难以稳定地将生成轨迹优化至目标人脸图像。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的两阶段白盒模型逆向方法——引导流模型逆向（SFMI），该方法将逆向任务重新定义为轨迹引导任务。具体而言，第一步，学习通用流匹配先验，预训练一个通用的无条件流匹配模型，以编码人脸流形作为稳健先验。第二步，使用渐进式引导调度器（PGS）进行攻击，在采样过程中注入随时间变化的目标特定梯度。通过目标模型反向传播，从中间生成状态获取梯度，PGS逐步引导生成过程。
tldr: 提出了一种基于梯度引导流匹配的两阶段白盒模型逆向方法，通过通用先验学习和渐进式引导调度器，稳定地引导生成轨迹以重建目标人脸图像，显著提升逆向攻击的精度和稳定性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-stage white-box model inversion method using gradient-guided flow matching, which learns a generic prior and progressively steers generation trajectories via a scheduler to stably reconstruct target face images, improving attack accuracy and stability.
